requirements.title: ASSOCIATED data TARGET cases compare nonzero storage, shape, and storage-unit overlap in array order
requirements.definition: With a scalar data TARGET, ASSOCIATED is true exactly when TARGET is not a zero-sized storage sequence and POINTER occupies the same storage units as TARGET. With an array data TARGET, ASSOCIATED is true exactly when POINTER has the same shape, the associated array is neither of size zero nor an array whose elements are zero-sized storage sequences, and the storage units are the same in array element order.
